description: This file defines a validator class for the Form object within the OpenMRS framework, ensuring that forms meet specific validation criteria such as non-null fields and proper formatting.

classes.name: FormValidator
classes.description: A Spring Validator implementation that validates Form objects for required fields and proper data formats.

methods.description: Checks if the validator supports the given class type (specifically supports Form).

methods.description: Performs validation on a Form object, checking for null/empty fields, regex matching for version, and field length constraints.
